description: Cloud-based data warehousing and data platform for data storage, processing, and analytics
auth_notes: Uses OAuth or Key Pair (JWT) to authenticate with the Snowflake server for API requests.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a trial account self-serve to obtain credentials.
api_notes: Provides a SQL API (REST) for running queries, managing deployment, handling DDL/DML, alongside extensive SDKs and drivers.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Snowflake directly as of current docs.
rationale: Snowflake offers a robust SQL REST API and client libraries, but credentials require a trial or paid account rather than a permanent free-tier developer plan.
